newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Placement shares of Wee Poh fully taken up - OUB.
newsitem.headline: Placement shares of Wee Poh fully taken up - OUB.

text.p: The 6.2 million placement shares offered by integrated infrastructure specialist Wee Poh Holdings Ltd in its initial public offer (IPO) have been fully taken up, lead manager Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) said on Monday.
"All the 6.2 million placement shares have been fully taken up by fund managers and institutions," said Richard Tan, senior vice president of OUB's investment banking and corporate finance division.
Wee Poh launched a 24.8 million-share IPO priced at Singapore $0.45 each, of which 18.6 million shares are being offered to the public and 6.2 million shares were placed out.
The offer will raise net proceeds of about S$7.5 million to be used for buying equipment, redeveloping an existing building to house the group's operations and for working capital.
